title: Enforce production layer dependency boundaries
goal: Extend boundary checks beyond business imports to platform and auth production dependencies, fix the platform violation, and freeze the remaining known violations as a review-dated baseline.
statusNote: 2026-09-23: scripts/harness/check-boundaries.mjs now scans business, platform and auth production code (backend Go + frontend TS), exempts test files, and supports --baseline. The platform -> system/org/dept violation is fixed by moving the adapter to the composition root (backend/cmd/server/platform_org_governance.go). The remaining 8 known findings are frozen in config/boundary-baseline.json with reasons and reviewBy=2026-12-31; ci.yml now runs the gate with --baseline so new violations fail CI. The auth model-level coupling to system/iam/user is explicitly deferred (needs a UserReader contract) rather than rushed in this pass.
technicalDebtNote: auth/login and auth/security still query the user GORM model directly (system/iam/user), and 1 platform type import + 4 auth shared-CSS imports remain. All are baselined with a 2026-12-31 review date and a stated ratchet; scripts/check-arch-boundaries.mjs still overlaps the harness checker and is not wired into CI.

in: extend check-boundaries.mjs with platform and auth rules (go + ts)
fix platform -> system/org/dept via composition-root adapter
out: refactoring auth/login and auth/security off the user model (deferred ratchet)
business behavior, API, database, permission, i18n changes

runtimeEvidence: boundary gate green with 8 baselined findings; platform package tests ok

humanGates: none required (no new permission surface, behavior-equivalent platform wiring) — PR gates + non-author review
